name: buildmapper
description: Building-permit intelligence for suppliers and trades in Canada: scored permits on a map, your pipeline and documents, and customer-list checks against new permits.

interface.longDescription: BuildMapper reads the building permits filed across British Columbia, Alberta and Ontario, names the builder on each, and scores every permit for the user's trade, territory and timing. Connected to ChatGPT, a BuildMapper user can search permits by place, date, type and value and see them on a map; open a project's details; check a customer list they already keep in a spreadsheet or CRM against current permits without importing it; read their pipeline, notes, calendar, watched builders, alerts, quotes, contracts and takeoffs; ask their own product catalog and ERP mirror where connected; and, after confirming, save leads, move stages, add notes, schedule follow-ups, watch builders, and start draft emails, quotes and contracts. It acts as the signed-in user with the same visibility rules as the app and never sends anything on the user's behalf.
defaultPrompt: Show me building permits over $1 million filed in Kelowna in the last 90 days
